description: INTEGRATION-CROSS-LANGUAGE 唯一索引：全專案跨語言呼叫、交接、錯誤表示、記憶體擁有權規則的唯一索引；本檔只做索引與規範，不複製任何 registry 內容；boundary 詳細 schema 仍以各 owner registry 為準；修訂與世代存於 metadata，不得由此推斷 identity 名稱。
revision_policy: identity names are stable (no version suffix, no final/latest/generation tokens). Revisions live in metadata only: contract_revision, generation, content_hash, producer, consumer, compatibility, created_at, source_revision.

metadata.note: rev2: Python lane retired (B36 Python=retired; B162/B167/B38 zero role/residency). python-involving boundaries carry status=retired tombstones; native successors are recorded per-entry.

rules: shared formal DTO / record / enum, single definition
prefer record, readonly struct, ReadOnlyMemory<T>, Memory<T>, Task<T>, ValueTask<T>
no JSON/HTTP/socket/extra IPC between C# and F#
exceptions converge to the formal error contract at the application boundary
stable C ABI on the public native boundary
C++ must not expose STL containers, C++ exceptions, template ABI, compiler-specific ABI
Rust must not expose enum layout, Vec, String, trait objects, panics
preferred types: fixed-width integers, enum codes, pointer, length, offset, flat structs
every struct carries struct_size and contract_revision metadata with ownership semantics
allocator owner, free owner, lifetime, mutability, thread safety and alignment are explicit
request identity, correlation identity, generation, contract revision

metadata.abi: C, extern-C, flat structs, status codes

metadata.transport: loopback HTTP/JSON or child-process stdio JSONL, no shared memory

metadata.note: identity is stable; format tokens and hashes live in artifact metadata, never in file or folder names
single Rust application state projected to JavaScript/GPUI/egui; JavaScript never touches backend authority directly

boundaries.retired_by: B162/B167/B38: Python lane retired; native successor is GPTBridge.MainSystem (C#) over native/bridge gptbridge_native.c
B162/B167/B38: Python inference retired; successor is cs-native-inference + native engine process

boundaries.mechanism: flat C ABI via NativeLibrary (no Python in path)
ctypes CDLL over flat C exports, python fallback
boundaries.retired_by: B162: Python caller retired; investment-mobile native surfaces remain under investment-mobile ownership
boundaries.contract_ref: module-local parity (no versioned contract file: see blockers)

boundaries.mechanism: in-process ProjectReference, F#-owned DTOs, no serialization
child-process stdio JSONL proxy plus loopback HTTP/WS; python transport_proxy sidecar retired (B162), native sidecar is native/tool_runtime/sidecar_transport.cpp
loopback HTTP/JSON, no FFI, no shared memory

boundaries.retired_by: B162: model_service_http.py retired; C# consumers use cs-native-inference (native ABI), governed channel for the rest

boundaries.mechanism: one-way file export checkpoint to inference bundle, sha256 chained
boundaries.retired_by: B162/B167/B38: python exporter retired; native training lane is native_transformer/training (C++/C#)

boundaries.mechanism: Tauri typed command whitelist plus events; single Rust state projected
authenticated loopback WebSocket with bounded queue, outbox cursors, reconnect; python ipc/server.py retired (B162), backend is GPTBridge.MainSystem (C#)
token-guarded loopback HTTP parent to worker process
spawn-per-call, stdin JSON job, stdout last-line JSON, no resident state; python spawner (julia_compute.py) retired (B162), spawn is owned by the C# orchestrator
process spawn with env bindings, file journal, single-instance mutex
Npgsql pool with contract handshake, session identity, generation fence; psycopg3/python lane retired (B162), canonical reader is GPTBridge.CodexPipeline
child-process stdio JSONL with per-call id, bounded line size; python transport_proxy.py retired (B162), native sidecar is native/tool_runtime/sidecar_transport.cpp

error_contract.description: unified cross-language error codes. Boundaries carry error_code plus bounded metadata plus correlation_id only. No stack traces cross trust boundaries; no free-form exception strings as decision conditions.

language_mapping.rust: Result<T, E> with code enums; never panic across boundary
language_mapping.cpp: std::expected / status codes; exceptions converted at the ABI edge
language_mapping.csharp: typed results; exceptions converge at the application boundary
language_mapping.fsharp: typed results (Result/Option); exceptions converge at the application boundary
language_mapping.python: retired (B162): no Python domain remains; wire codes unchanged

rules: every native struct declares allocator owner, free owner, lifetime, mutability, thread safety, alignment
same-process hot paths target zero-copy or one-copy; cross-process prefers formal binary IPC

canonical owners: C++ owns weight bundles with stable addresses; Rust owns vectord store; callers own opaque handles and transfer buffers. (Python/pybind memory edge retired with B162 — memory_contract.py removed.)

known_relays.reason: governed AI channel, permission routing and audit (B162: python hops retired)
primary C# path is the native ABI; the python model-service-http hop is retired (B162)
network isolation: only the Go service touches the public web, metadata only

blockers.reason: ad-hoc 0/1/2/3 codes, no contract file, no registry entry; needs owner declaration
resolved by file existence only; needs a versioned contract file under investment-mobile ownership
engine image resolved by newest mtime (implicit versioning); needs content-hash pinning
Codex amendment landed (B162/B167/B38): Python routing/facade on the local-model inference path is retired; native engine + cs-native-inference own the path
gptbridge_invoke is a single raw-JSON envelope; per-command typed structs plus generated TS bindings are future work under system-runtime
